title: {{NAME}} and the Enchanted Soccer Garden
moral: Playing fair and having fun matters more than winning.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} found a soccer field in a royal garden.
Roses and tall hedges grew all around.
A princess in a blue gown kicked a ball.
A white unicorn watched from the garden gate.
{{NAME}} had never seen a place so lovely.
